title: build: fix remote seccomp default
body:
Fixes: #24318

- Podman remote was sending the client's default seccomp profile path to the server during builds when no seccomp option was specified. 
- Remote server fails to read the path as it was only for client. 
- This patch clears the client's default seccomp path afther Buildah option parsing so that the remote server uses it's own default seccomp.

comments.body: @jiwahn the tests aren't happy..  There's a small chance that a rebase and push might fix that.  Can you try that please?
Hmm but the branch is already up to date.

> This would allow buildah to pick the default seccomp config and at the same time, doesn't affect seccomp-enabled builds.

SGTM, I agree the client side must not care about the seccomp build tag and work regardless, such checks must be performed on the server side. This goes back to my other comment here about the lacking client/server abstractions in the cli.

Just to confirm, is the issue that the remote client is sending values from the containers.conf and defaults, in addition to explicitly specified CLI options (and the client should only send cli options)? Let me know if this fix is still valid.
